acceptance_criteria.statement: A Plan slide can reference Tasks, and the reader shows which ones with a link to each.
A referenced Task's done state shows on the slide.
Marking a Task done changes what its slides show without anyone republishing those slides.

content.statement: As a developer, I can see on a Plan's slides which Tasks they reference and which of those are done, so the deck itself tells me how far the work has come.
content.title: See progress on the slides

state.reason: Verified against the code and tests on 2026-11-02. A slide lists its Tasks and how many are done, worked out when it renders.
